subtitle: Out Manila · Juneyao Airlines
overview: Fly Juneyao Airlines to Shanghai for Nanjing Road, the Bund and Zhang Garden, then visit Wuxi’s Nianhua Bay (Mini Kyoto) at night and Hangzhou’s West Lake. A special Spring Festival activity lets you write Spring Festival couplets and make your own dumplings for lunch. Includes free-upgrade Yuyuan hot pot and BBQ meals. 4-star hotels; a shopping-stop package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 31–Feb 5 2027 to Feb 7–12 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's best-known shopping street, lined with stores, restaurants and neon signs.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade with historic buildings facing the Pudong skyline; photo stop.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: Shanghai's TV tower with its distinctive spheres; photo stop.
placeDesc.Starbucks flagship store Shanghai: Starbucks' huge flagship roastery in Shanghai, billed as the world's largest Starbucks.
placeDesc.Zhang Garden: A historic Shanghai garden-style compound with old lane houses.
placeDesc.Huaihai Road: A leading shopping street in Shanghai's former French Concession.
placeDesc.Nianhua Bay (Mini Kyoto): A Japanese-style night-view scenic spot in Wuxi, nicknamed the Mini Kyoto of China.
placeDesc.The Grand Canal Hangzhou: The Hangzhou section of China's Grand Canal, the world's longest man-made waterway.
placeDesc.Gongchen Bridge: A historic arched stone bridge over the Grand Canal in Hangzhou.
placeDesc.West Lake: Hangzhou's famous UNESCO-listed lake, strolled along to enjoy the wintersweet blossoms.
placeDesc.Meijiawu Tea Garden: A tea-growing village in Hangzhou with a Hanfu experience and Spring Festival activities.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: A traditional temple area in old Shanghai with a business area for free shopping.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland: Optional tour on the free day, USD 140 per person including ticket and transfers.
placeDesc.Jinmao Tower: Optional tour of the 88th-floor sightseeing hall of the Jinmao Tower in Pudong.
placeDesc.Xintiandi: A Shanghai district of restored stone-gate (Shikumen) houses turned into cafes and shops; optional tour.
